from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,datetime
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
log=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl')
print('CURRENT_SHA',(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip())
print('ACCOUNT_SESSIONS',len(list(vault.glob('*.session'))))
src=(root/'scripts/safe_runtime.py').read_text()
print('QUEUE_METRICS_CODE_PRESENT', 'approved_queue_snapshot' in src and 'approved_queue_waiting' in src)
entries=[]
if log.is_file():
 for line in log.open(encoding='utf-8'):
  try: obj=json.loads(line)
  except ValueError: continue
  event=obj.get('event') if isinstance(obj,dict) else None
  if isinstance(event,dict) and event.get('kind')=='cycle':
   entries.append((obj.get('ts'),event))
 print('TOTAL_CYCLES',len(entries))
 for ts,event in entries[-5:]:
  queue=event.get('approved_queue')
  print('RECENT_CYCLE',ts,'QUEUE_KEYS',sorted(queue.keys()) if isinstance(queue,dict) else None,'QUEUE_TOTALS',queue if isinstance(queue,dict) else None,'ACTION_COUNTS',len(event.get('member_actions',[]) or []))
r=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'})
if r.returncode:
 print('PM2_READ_FAILED',r.returncode)
else:
 workers=[x for x in json.loads(r.stdout) if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
 print('PM2_MATCHES',len(workers))
 if len(workers)==1:print('PM2_STATUS',workers[0].get('pm2_env',{}).get('status'))
print('READONLY_POSTDEPLOY_COMPLETE')
